{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute the count of completed orders
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]
print(completed_orders)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check their status
qa_status_counts = qa_orders['status'].value_counts()
print(f'QA order statuses: {qa_status_counts.to_dict() if not qa_status_counts.empty else {}}')"}
